name: Last 30 Days Skill
description: last-30-days is a Claude Code skill that searches the web and delivers a structured 30-day digest on any topic you choose. Simply ask Claude about a subject and it will run targeted searches, filter for the most recent content, and summarize findings into four sections: Top Highlights, Key Trends, Notable Sources (with links), and a Quick Takeaway. Ideal for staying current on fast-moving topics like AI, tech releases, regulations, or industry news — without manually browsing dozens of sites.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `last30days` (Research what people actually say about any topic in the last 30 days) and **1 hook**, `SessionStart`.

Installs with `claude plugin install last-30-days-skill@claude-community` from `mvanhorn/last30days-skill`.
